Adjustable Cracking Pressures

(felirat nélkül) (figure): Sectional view of a CPA series check valve (compact, one-piece body) with callouts: fully contained O-ring seal, adjustable spring, adjusting screw sets cracking pressure, locking screw maintains setting. Use it to find how the cracking pressure of a CPA valve is set and locked.

CA and CPA Series
Cracking Pressure, bar (figure): Chart for the CA and CPA series: reseal pressure (psi and bar) as a band over cracking pressure (psi and bar) from 0 to 600 psi, with a dashed example at 450 psi cracking giving 390 to 450 psi reseal; negative reseal values are marked 'Back Pressure'. Answers what seal material the CH ratings assume and that the end connection can limit the rating.

Cleaning and Packaging (text_section): Cleaning and Packaging: C, CA and CH valves with VCR or VCO end connections are processed to Swagelok SC-11 (MS-06-63, ASTM G93 Level C); all other C, CA, CH valves and all CP and CPA valves are cleaned to SC-10 (MS-06-62). Answers which cleaning and packaging specification applies to a given series and end connection.

Dimensions (text_section): Dimensions note on page 11: dimensions are shown with Swagelok tube fitting nuts finger-tight, for reference only and subject to change. Answers how the dimensions in the C and CA dimensions table are to be read.

Seal Materials (All Series) (text_section): Seal material option for all series: FKM O-rings standard in 316 SS valves, Buna N in brass valves; other elastomer seals available by inserting the seal material designator into the ordering number. Answers which seal material is standard and how to order another one.

C, CP, CA, and CPA Series Seal Kits (text_section): C, CP, CA and CPA seal kits: contain an O-ring and instructions; for PTFE kits replace the material designator with T and omit the durometer number (example T-4C-K4). Answers what a seal kit contains and how to order a PTFE seal kit.

CH Series Seal Kits (text_section): CH series seal kits: contain bonded poppet, body seal O-ring, PTFE backup ring and instructions; add a seal material designator to the basic kit number (example SS-3K-CH4-VI). Answers what a CH seal kit contains and how its ordering number is formed.

Cracking and Reseal Pressures at 70°F (20℃) (text_section): Cracking and Reseal Pressures at 70°F (20°C): definitions of cracking, reseal and back pressure and the caution about higher initial cracking pressure after a period without actuation. Answers how cracking, reseal and back pressure are defined for the page 4 tables.

Special Cleaning and Packaging (SC-11) (text_section): Special cleaning and packaging SC-11 (MS-06-63, ASTM G93 Level C): standard for C, CA and CH valves with VCR or VCO ends, orderable for other end connections with -SC11 (example SS-2C-1/3-SC11). Answers how to order SC-11 cleaning for valves that do not have it as standard.

Warranty Information (text_section): Warranty information (Swagelok Limited Lifetime Warranty), trademarks (VCR, VCO, Swagelok) and the catalog identification MS-01-176, RevN, December 2025. Answers which warranty applies and which catalog revision this is.

Technical Data (text_section): Technical Data definitions: cracking pressure (inlet pressure at the first indication of flow), reseal pressure (no indication of flow) and back pressure (differential between inlet and outlet), plus the caution that initial cracking pressure may be higher after a period without actuation. Answers how cracking, reseal and back pressure are defined in this catalog.

CA and C Series Metal Gasket Kits - table 1 (table): Metal gasket kits for the CA and C series in two parts: basic kit ordering numbers per valve series (2C/4C, 6C/8C, 12C/16C, CA, with the number of gaskets) and the gasket material designators (316 SS SS, alloy 400 M, aluminum A), with availability footnotes. Use it to find the basic metal gasket kit ordering number and the gasket material designator.

Check Valves (text_section): Cover page: C, CA, CH, CP and CPA series check valves with working pressures up to 6000 psig (413 bar), adjustable and fixed cracking pressures, a variety of end connections and 316 stainless steel and brass materials. Answers which series the catalog covers and their maximum working pressure, cracking pressure types and materials.

Testing (text_section): Testing: every C, CA, CH, CP and CPA valve is factory tested for crack and reseal; fixed cracking pressure valves are cycled six times before testing, adjustable ones are tested at a low and a high pressure setting; seats have a maximum allowable leak rate of 1 std cm3/min nitrogen. Answers how the check valves are factory tested and what seat leak rate is allowed.

CH Series Spring Kits (text_section): CH spring kits (spring, two cracking pressure labels, instructions; example 302-13K-CH4-1/3), deflector cap kits (one polyethylene cap in red or green) and the Safe Product Selection statement (system designer and user are responsible for function, compatibility, ratings, installation, operation and maintenance). Answers what CH spring and deflector cap kits contain and who is responsible for safe product selection.

CH Series Seal Kits - table 1 (table): CH series seal kits in two parts: basic kit ordering numbers per valve series (CH4, CH8, CH16) and valve body material (316 SS, alloy 400), and the seal material designators (Buna N BN, ethylene propylene EP, fluorocarbon FKM VI, neoprene NE). Use it to find the basic CH seal kit ordering number and the seal material designator to append.

Deflector Caps (4C, 8C, CP, and CPA Series) (text_section): Deflector cap option for 4C, 8C, CP and CPA valves with male NPT ends: polyethylene cap that deflects flow away from personnel and keeps contaminants out, rated 300 psig at 100°F (20.6 bar at 37°C); -DG green or -DR red (example SS-4CPA2-DR-3).
